explication: valkey-swift is a Swift Valkey/Redis client library. Its main workflow accepts typed commands, routes them through a standalone or cluster client, leases pooled connections, encodes RESP3 requests, and decodes responses. It also supports transactions, pipelining, Pub/Sub, Sentinel, and Valkey command families. Connections and RESP layers are evidenced in sampled source; several feature branches are included based on README capabilities, with unverified internal links omitted.
